title: The Man Who Sold the Eiffel Tower… Twice 🗼 #shorts
description:
Would you have bought it? Yes or no?

In 1925 a con man posed as a government official and sold the Eiffel Tower for scrap. Then he came back and did it again.

Sources: Smithsonian Magazine, Mental Floss, Britannica
